_comment: Bar-aligned edit of the raw Eleven Music take onto the timeline. Specific to take 2 (music_v1, seed 2026); a new take needs a new edit list. Times are on the musical grid (multiples of 0.5 s); the source's beat grid offset (beatOffset, measured by beats.mjs + phase check) is added to every time. Analysis of the raw take (tools/audio/work/music/score.take2.raw.mp3): 0-8 hits, 8-20 groove, 20-24 sparse dropout, 24-44 lighter groove (F# minor), 44-52 breakdown, 52-56 riser, DROP at 56, full groove 56-92, drumless F# major outro 92-104 that decays to silence. The model put the drop 8 s late (it asked for 48), so the edit removes 8 s before the drop and repeats 4 groove bars after it.

segments.why: S05b falls away into the breakdown tail, S06 = the composed riser (s52-56)
the composed DROP lands on the logo/S07 boundary (T48)
repeat 4 groove bars (s80-88) to give back the 8 s
groove to 92, then the composed drumless F# major outro for S09

gain.why: S05b near silence under 'So how does a buyer know it's clean?'

sweeps.why: S05a rising tension: filter opens over 6 bars
S08 lift: groove thins out, snaps back full on the stitch hit

subHits.why: S05: single deep sub hit as everything falls away

cues.what: punchy hits on every beat (kick + stabs)
groove, F# minor; sparse dropout 20-24 (under L07)
groove under a low-pass opening 1 kHz -> 18 kHz (rising tension)
falls away: deep sub hit on 40, then near silence (-14 dB breakdown tail)
DROP on 48, driving four-on-the-floor groove, claps on 2 and 4
lift: groove thins (high-pass sweep 30 Hz -> 900 Hz)
stitch hit on 88: full groove slams back + sub hit
drumless F# major outro; swell on 96, decays to silence by ~103.5
